description.value: Woody's is a well-established neighbourhood pub in Coquitlam that has been serving the community since 1932. It is best known for its extensive tap selection — over 30 beers including 15 rotating BC craft beers — and its famously inexpensive wings. An attached liquor store and cannabis shop operate on the same premises, making it a one-stop destination on Brunette Avenue.
